name: The Atlanta Journal-Constitution editorial board
lean_basis: Georgia's largest newspaper. The AJC announced in 2009 that it would no longer endorse political candidates, saying readers 'don't need the paper to tell them how to vote' (Editor & Publisher). It publishes voter guides and explainers instead. AllSides rates its news coverage Lean Left.

name: League of Women Voters of Georgia (VOTE411)
lean_basis: Nonpartisan; never endorses candidates. Its VOTE411 Georgia page carries voting rules and candidate questionnaire answers. No 2026 positions on the three amendments were found on lwvga.org or VOTE411.

name: Democratic Party of Georgia
lean_basis: Official state party organization. Its county affiliates (Fulton County Democrats) publish the statewide nominee slate.

name: Georgia Republican Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization; publishes a 2026 statewide candidate guide of its nominees.

name: Georgia Chamber of Commerce
lean_basis: Statewide business lobby. Its 2026 statewide endorsements found so far (Jackson for governor, Harper for agriculture) are both Republicans; it has backed Democrats in some legislative races in past cycles.

name: NFIB Georgia PAC (National Federation of Independent Business)
lean_basis: Small-business lobby PAC. Its Oct 15, 2026 statewide slate is all Republicans; it says it endorses on 'positions and voting records on key small-business issues.'

name: Sierra Club Georgia Chapter
lean_basis: Environmental advocacy group; its 2026 general election slate endorses only Democrats.

name: Planned Parenthood Action Fund / Planned Parenthood Southeast Advocates
lean_basis: Abortion-rights advocacy PAC. Its Sept 11, 2026 Georgia endorsements are all Democrats who pledge to repeal the state's six-week abortion law.

name: Georgia Equality PAC
lean_basis: LGBTQ advocacy PAC; its 2026 general election slate endorses only Democrats.

name: Fair Fight
lean_basis: Voting-rights group founded by Stacey Abrams; its November 2026 slate endorses only Democrats.

name: Georgia Fraternal Order of Police
lean_basis: Statewide police union. Endorsed Republican Rick Jackson for governor in October 2026 (reported by Fox 5 Atlanta via the Jackson campaign). Has endorsed candidates of both parties in past cycles.

name: LIBRE State PAC
lean_basis: Hispanic political organization tied to the Koch-backed LIBRE Initiative; endorsed Republican Rick Jackson citing education, property taxes and deregulation.

name: Georgia Farm Bureau
lean_basis: Largest farm organization in the state. Does not endorse; publishes candidate bios and agriculture questionnaire answers for every statewide race.

name: Professional Association of Georgia Educators (PAGE)
lean_basis: Largest educator association in Georgia (not a union). States 'PAGE does not endorse candidates or provide campaign contributions.' Hosts a superintendent candidate forum.
